lines.text: Many learners say: If I get home, I will call you.
Better: When I get home, I will call you.
When! When the film ends, we will go home.

data.wrong: If I get home, I will call you.
data.right: When I get home, I will call you.

native.tip: Wenn etwas sicher passiert, sagen Sie „when“, nicht „if“.
